articles.title: Who will exit Chelsea? How Blues could cut 41-man squad
articles.summary: With 25 days until the transfer window closes, Chelsea will be working hard to cut their 41-man senior squad. But who could be heading out?

articles.title: Argentina mark World Cup win over England with 'National Football Teams Day'
articles.summary: The Argentine Football Association announces 15 July as National Football Teams Day to mark Argentina's 2026 World Cup semi-final victory over England.
